newsitem.title: USA: TRW Inc wins $243 mln government contract.
newsitem.headline: TRW Inc wins $243 mln government contract.

text.p: TRW Inc said it has been awarded a $243.4 million contract by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention to provide programming and related services that will take the agency into the next century.
The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is an agency of the Department of Health and Human services.
Over the next five years, TRW will develop, test and install software specifically designed to aid the CDC's research efforts.
TRW said transitioning the CDC's software into the year 2000 will be an important part of the contract.
